findings.summary: Instructions look too generic or too thin to guide an agent reliably.
findings.recommendation: Make the file specific to this repo: mission, architecture, safety boundaries, and exact commands.

findings.summary: Instructions are too short to establish reliable behavior.
findings.recommendation: Aim for a focused one-to-three page instruction file with links to deeper skills or docs.

findings.summary: No dedicated skill files were found.
findings.recommendation: Extract specialized instructions into skill files (for example .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, agents/*.SKILL.md, or .cursor/rules) when the root instructions get dense.
findings.title: Specialized agent skills are separated

findings.summary: Scripts mention lint, typecheck, test, but no single quality gate ties them together.
findings.recommendation: Add a `check` script or quality-gate hook that agents can run before finishing.
findings.title: Deterministic quality gate exists

findings.summary: No secret scanning hook or script was found.
findings.recommendation: Add a secrets check before agent-authored changes can be committed or merged.
